title: MorfFlex: Handling Rich Morphology
abstract: arXiv:2606.24366v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present MorfFlex, a morphological dictionary architecture suitable for languages with extensive regularity in both inflection and derivation. As the primary example of MorfFlex in use we introduce MorfFlex CZ, a morphological dictionary of Czech. It is distributed as a simple, unstructured list of  triplets, however, its manually maintained, unpublished source files and conversion scripts encode a sophisticated system of inflectional and derivational patterns. These patterns dramatically reduce the otherwise enormous size of the dictionary, which currently contains over 100 million wordforms and more than 1 million lemmas. The MorfFlex CZ dictionary serves as an essential resource for ensuring the consistency of manual morphological annotation in the Prague Dependency Treebanks and underpins state-of-the-art automatic tools such as MorphoDiTa. translated_abstract: 我们提出了MorfFlex，这是一种适用于屈折变化和派生构词都高度规律的语言的形态词典架构。作为MorfFlex实际应用的主要示例，我们介绍了MorfFlex CZ——一个捷克语形态词典。它以简单的、非结构化的三元组列表形式发布，但其人工维护的未公开源文件和转换脚本编码了一套复杂的屈折和派生模式系统。这些模式极大地压缩了词典本应庞大的规模——该词典目前包含超过1亿个词形和100多万个词元。MorfFlex CZ词典是确保布拉格依存树库中人工形态标注一致性的重要资源，并支撑了MorphoDiTa等最先进的自动语言处理工具。在本文中，我们重点关注：(i) 提出一种有效管理丰富形态的方法……
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过屈折和派生模式系统来紧凑编码海量词形的形态词典架构MorfFlex，并发布了包含超过1亿词形的捷克语形态词典MorfFlex CZ，为布拉格依存树库的人工标注一致性和MorphoDiTa等先进自动工具提供了关键资源。
en_tdlr: We present MorfFlex, a morphological dictionary architecture that encodes inflectional and derivational patterns to compactly represent over 100 million Czech wordforms, providing an essential resource for consistent manual annotation in the Prague Dependency Treebanks and supporting state-of-the-art tools like MorphoDiTa.
